title: DOW-UAP-D62, Mission Report, Strait of Hormuz, September 2020
doc_notes: This is a declassified military mission report (MISREP) detailing ISR operations, which includes a brief mention of a UAP observation via sensor data.

encounters.summary: An unmanned aerial asset observed a UAP via Full Motion Video (FMV) while conducting ISR operations in the Arabian Gulf.
